title: feat(spec,runtime,plugin-audit): an action run through MCP leaves an audit row naming its surface
body:
🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

https://claude.ai/code/session_017ihL2fi9zfJhUTubyJYb6V

Fixes #27908

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 每次通过 REST 动作门（控制台按钮、SDK）或 MCP（AI agent 的 `run_action` / `resume_run`）调用业务动作，审计日志 `sys_audit_log` 都多一行 `action_invocation`，`metadata.surface` 写明 `rest` 还是 `mcp`；agent 代人调用时同一行还带 `performed_by` / `on_behalf_of`。四个分支（脚本、api 转发、flow、声明式更新）都写，成功和分派后被拒都写。
- **为什么改：** 执行 #27681 裁决 6513869839 参数 3：管理员要在审计日志里分清"agent 调的"和"人点的"，不需要第二份日志。之前只有脚本分支打一条 `console.info`，其余三个分支什么都不留。
- **风险与回滚：** 只新增审计写入，不改授权、不改哪个门能跑哪个动作；审计写失败只打一次 `error` 日志，动作本身的结果不变。回滚即回退本 PR，已写入的审计行留在账本里。
- **先看：** ① `packages/spec/src/kernel/execution-context.zod.ts` 新键 `surface`（取值 `rest` / `mcp`）；② `packages/runtime/src/action-invocation-audit.ts`（门如何盖上自己的 surface、为何 api 转发不需要额外的头）；③ `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/action-invocation-audit.ts`（审计行的形状）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/action-invocation-audit.test.ts`，预期 `Tests 24 passed`：四个分支 × 两个门各写一行，伪造的转发头和上游 `surface` 都改不了记录的门。
- **需要你做的：** 批准键名 `ExecutionContext.surface` 及其取值 `rest` / `mcp`（连同 `sys_audit_log.action` 新值 `action_invocation`）。

Independent review: none run (quota); the PR waits for the seat's contract-review hand-off.

## What changes

**The key — `ExecutionContext.surface`** (`@objectstack/spec`). `z.enum(['rest', 'mcp']).optional()`, with the `performedBy` docblock discipline (ADR-0090 D10 rule 4): set only by the two action doors, from the door's own identity, on the envelope of the invocation they record; never client-supplied; attribution only (no middleware reads it, never an authorization subject, scope or gate). The enum is closed to the doors that invoke an action today: `rest` (REST `POST /actions/:object/:action`) and `mcp` (the `/mcp` bridge's `run_action` / `resume_run`). No other door invokes a business action: flow action nodes and the declarative endpoint executor do not route through either door (measured: `invokeBusinessAction` has one caller, `domains/mcp.ts`). **The maintainer approves the key name and its values in this PR.** `@objectstack/core` lists it as a non-entry field (identity resolution does not produce it; the same credential reaches both doors).

**The doors** (`@objectstack/runtime`). `action-invocation-audit.ts` holds the door half: `withActionSurface(ec, surface)` (a COPY of the caller's envelope with the surface overwritten, so the request's own envelope is unchanged and nothing upstream can move the value) and `recordActionInvocation`, which resolves the `audit` service slot and hands it one event. Each door's post-gate dispatch is split into its own function, code unchanged, so the door can write the row for whatever that dispatch answers:

- REST: `handleActionsRequest` → `dispatchAdmittedRestAction`; the row reads the answered status (and `error.code`).
- MCP `run_action`: `invokeBusinessAction` → `dispatchAdmittedBusinessAction`; the row reads the thrown error through `resolveThrownHttpError`.
- MCP `resume_run`: `resumeActionRun` → `continueAdmittedRun` (steps 4–6); the row names the admitting flow action and carries the `run_id`.

**Which calls write a row, and why.** Every call that cleared its door's admission gates and reached its branch: the branch's success, and every refusal from there on (the subject-record verdict, a declarative write the data plane refused, an api target's non-2xx, the api loop refusal, a flow run that failed, a body that threw, "no handler registered"). A call refused by an admission gate (not found, the `sys_*` / `ai.exposed` gates, ADR-0066 D4 `requiredPermissions`, the ADR-0126 activation switch, the param contract, the confirmation gate, and for `resume_run` steps 1–3) ran nothing and writes no row: the ruling asks to tell an agent's run from a click, and those calls ran nothing.

**The row** (`@objectstack/plugin-audit`). `createActionInvocationAuditWriter` joins `createAuthEventAuditSink` on the `audit` slot (`recordActionInvocation`). It fits `sys_audit_log` with **no new field**: `action: 'action_invocation'` (a new value of the existing `action` select, added writer-first; `sys-audit-log-retired-actions.test.ts` names its writer), `user_id` / `actor` / `tenant_id` from the envelope by the CRUD mirror's rules, `object_name` + `record_id` for the subject (so the ledger's record read gate judges it), no snapshots and no params, and `metadata` = `{ surface, action_name, branch, outcome, status?, error_code?, run_id?, performed_by?, on_behalf_of? }`. A lost row is reported once per cause at `error` (`persistActionInvocationAuditRow` is registered in `DURABILITY_CRITICAL_CALLEES`). The `[action-audit]` log line is kept and is not the row.

**The api forward.** The row on the `api` branch is written by the door after the in-process forward answers, from the door's own envelope, which the target's re-authentication never replaces; so it names the true door with no surface header on the forward (pinned: the forwarded request carries none, and the row says `mcp`). See Acceptance notes for why no trusted forward header was added.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/action-invocation-audit.test.ts` (24): every branch × both doors (REST through `HttpDispatcher.handleActions`, MCP through the real `buildMcpBridge`) hands the slot exactly one event with the right `surface`, `branch`, `outcome`; a refusal after dispatch on every branch × both doors records `failed` with the door's status and code; the subject-record 404 writes one failed row per door; a D4-gated call writes none; the forged-header case (an outside REST request carrying the forward mark, an `x-objectstack-action-surface: mcp` header and an upstream `surface: 'mcp'` still records `rest`; an MCP call arriving as `surface: 'rest'` still records `mcp`); the api row after the forward; the request envelope left unchanged; the agent's `performedBy` beside the surface; `resume_run` success and refusal rows.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/action-invocation-audit.test.ts` (7): through a real ObjectQL engine, a click and an agent's call of the same action land as two rows that differ by `surface` and `performed_by`; a refusal's status/code and a resume's run id; object-less actions; no guessed surface; the `actor`-less ledger; the once-per-cause `error` report with no throw.
- `sys-audit-log-retired-actions.test.ts`: `action_invocation` added to the writer inventory. `assemble-execution-context.test.ts`: `surface` added to the non-entry mirror.

**Ablation** (one-shot, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation proven on disk, restored by blob hash):

- runtime: `await sink.recordActionInvocation(event);` → removed ⇒ `action-invocation-audit.test.ts` **20 failed | 4 passed** (the 4 are the no-row gate case and the helper cases); restored blob `d014ccafe5bb`.
- plugin-audit: `await persistActionInvocationAuditRow(engine, row);` → removed ⇒ **3 failed | 4 passed** (every read-back case); restored blob `9d2076906454`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Metadata-protocol: `added`, not the claim's `none`** (the order asked to check `pr-automation.yml`'s WHICH LEVEL table and follow it). The table's gate (`check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `none-baseline-moved`) refuses `none` when an `authorable-surface/` shard moves, and this key moves `packages/spec/authorable-surface/kernel.json` (`kernel/ExecutionContext:surface`, regenerated by the build — the shard lists every `ExecutionContext` key). So the declaration is `added` and every moved package's changeset is `minor` (spec, core, runtime, plugin-audit).
- **No trusted surface header on the api forward** (deviation from the order's suggested route; the seat decides). Measured: (1) the row does not need it, as above; (2) the forward mark the PM assumption leans on carries no trust — any outside caller can send `x-objectstack-action-forward`, and its only effect is the loop refusal — so a surface header "honoured with the same trust" would be honoured from any caller, letting an agent's call record `rest`; (3) a sound carry needs a new in-process credential, and each face that resolves an envelope (`resolveRequestExecutionContext` has seven door callers) would have to honour it; (4) no far-side writer would read it: the CRUD mirror's hook provenance carries `flowRunId` / `attributedUserId` / `performedByClientId` only, and the `sys_*` identity targets write through better-auth's adapter under its own system context. Carrying the surface onto the CRUD rows of the target's writes is a separate change (HookContext provenance + objectql), not made here.
- `sys_audit_log` gains an enum VALUE, not a field. `tenant_id` is the caller's active organization (`ExecutionContext.tenantId`); the CRUD mirror prefers the record's own organization, which this row does not read.
- Read from code, not measured: an OAuth-token agent's `api` action forward reaches its target with the bearer the dispatcher honours only on `/mcp` paths (`acceptOAuthAccessToken` path match, `http-dispatcher.ts`), so the target would resolve the caller as anonymous. Out of this card; reported to the seat.
